title: Pan-Seared Bass with Oceanic Soup
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring pan-seared bass served with a light and refreshing oceanic soup.
instructions: Rinse the bass fillets and pat them dry with a paper towel.
Season the bass with salt and black pepper.
Heat butter in an oven-safe skillet over medium-high heat. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the bass to the skillet and sear for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 8-10 minutes or until the bass is cooked through.
Meanwhile, prepare the oceanic soup according to the package instructions.
Serve the pan-seared bass with a side of oceanic soup.
Squeeze lemon juice over the bass before serving.
